Another person, Person 2, is walking ahead of you the same way, 3 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are, and you are overtaking them. You will move to your left to pass. raw_output:
Your left
Because you are both facing the same direction, moving to your left puts you on Person 2’s left side.
